title: CostEstimate
description: Ticket spend and exact-match expectation. expected_return_jpy is never derived from a coverage figure, because coverage at tolerance >= 1 is not a prize condition in any of these games.

exact_match_probability.description: n_tickets / outcome_space. This, not coverage, is the win probability.

expected_return_jpy.description: Null unless a payout table is configured. Must never be computed from coverage.
